title: cerastium dinaricum var. hekuravense
intro: Cerastium dinaricum var. hekuravense, commonly known as a variety of the Dinaric stonecrop, is a type of flowering plant in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of wounds, skin issues, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Cerastium dinaricum var. hekuravense include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
